name: cable seated chest fly
description: A seated fly on the cable machine that isolates the chest with constant tension.
instructions: Sit on a bench between two cable stacks with the pulleys at chest height.
Grab a handle in each hand and hold your arms out with soft elbows.
Press your back firmly into the bench.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze, then open your arms slowly.
Stop when you feel a good stretch.
